skill.name: tiktok-automation
skill.description: Automate TikTok publishing, photo posts, video listings, and account profile checks through Rube MCP.
skill.summary: Run TikTok publishing and profile workflows through Rube MCP.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around tool names, parameters, and pseudocode. The confirmed risk is the external Rube MCP endpoint, plus contextual risks from third-party OAuth routing and automated TikTok publishing.

remediation.suggestion: Disclose that TikTok OAuth, profile data, media uploads, and publish actions are routed through Rube MCP. Require user-owned connections only.
Require explicit user approval for account, media file, caption, privacy level, and final publish action before posting video or photo content.
Clarify that backticked tool names are MCP tool identifiers and not shell commands. Avoid fenced pseudocode when a numbered list is sufficient.

static_findings.snippet: - Active TikTok connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `tiktok`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
- `max_count`: Number of videos to return per page
- Pagination uses cursor-based approach; check for `has_more` and `cursor` in response
- `publish_id`: The publish ID from a previous upload/publish operation
- Use `cursor` from previous response for next page
- Check `has_more` boolean to determine if more results exist
- Response data may be nested under `data` or `data.data`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Poll at reasonable intervals (5-10 seconds) to avoid rate limits
1. Upload video via TIKTOK_UPLOAD_VIDEO -> get publish_id
2. Poll TIKTOK_FETCH_PUBLISH_STATUS with publish_id until complete

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The setup, OAuth connection, and account profile/stat workflows are explicitly documented. The risk is a contextual trust boundary, not hidden code execution.

semantic_findings.title: Automated Public Publishing Requires Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill guides agents to upload and publish videos or photos, including public privacy settings. These account-changing actions can create public content if an agent acts on an ambiguous request.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented workflows explicitly include required publish tools and privacy parameters. The risk is high-confidence because the actions modify a real TikTok account.

content.user_title: Automate TikTok Publishing with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Manual TikTok publishing slows teams when uploads, statuses, and privacy settings must stay consistent. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides Rube MCP setup and TikTok OAuth connection checks.
Searches current Rube tool schemas before TikTok workflow execution.
Uploads videos, polls processing status, and publishes completed videos.
Posts photo content with captions and privacy settings.
Lists published videos and reads authenticated account profile or stats.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP server and a connected TikTok account.
Can only access the authenticated user's TikTok data.
Does not bypass TikTok API limits, moderation, or content requirements.
Tool schemas may change and must be checked before each workflow.

use_cases.title: Publish Campaign Videos
use_cases.description: Upload approved campaign media, monitor processing, and publish with the selected caption and privacy level.

use_cases.title: Review Account Content
use_cases.description: List recent published videos and inspect account statistics for planning and reporting.

use_cases.title: Validate Publish Status
use_cases.description: Check whether a recent upload is processing, ready, successful, or failed before taking the next action.

prompt_templates.title: Check TikTok Connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Rube MCP to confirm my TikTok connection is active. Do not publish or upload anything.

prompt_templates.title: List Recent Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: List my recent TikTok videos with titles, creation times, share links, and any pagination details.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Video Publish
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload this approved video, check processing status, and ask me to confirm the caption and privacy level before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Publish Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the publish status for this publish ID, explain any failure reason, and recommend the next safe action without retrying automatically.

output_examples.input: Publish this product video to TikTok after upload.
output_examples.output: The assistant confirms the account, media file, caption, and privacy level, then uploads the video, checks processing, and publishes only after approval.
A concise list of published videos with titles, creation times, share links, and guidance for loading the next page.

output_examples.input: Check whether my last publish is complete.
output_examples.output: A status summary explains whether processing succeeded, is still pending, or failed with an actionable reason.

best_practices: Confirm the TikTok account, media file, caption, and privacy level before publishing.
Use Rube tool search first so parameters match current MCP schemas.
Poll publish status with backoff and stop on clear success or failure.
anti_patterns: Publishing with public privacy before the user approves the final caption.
Reusing old tool schemas without checking the current Rube MCP response.
Polling publish status too frequently after upload.

faq.question: Does this skill publish directly to TikTok?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides Rube MCP tool calls that can upload and publish content for the authenticated TikTok account.

faq.question: Does it need a TikTok connection?
faq.answer: Yes. The user must connect TikTok through Rube MCP and complete OAuth before workflows can run.

faq.question: Can it view other TikTok users?
faq.answer: No. The documented profile and video tools are for the authenticated user only.

faq.question: Can it avoid TikTok moderation or rate limits?
faq.answer: No. TikTok format rules, moderation, OAuth scopes, and rate limits still apply.

faq.question: Should agents confirm before publishing?
faq.answer: Yes. Agents should confirm the account, file, caption, and privacy level before any publish action.

faq.question: Why search tools before each workflow?
faq.answer: Rube MCP tool schemas can change. Searching first reduces parameter mistakes and failed requests.
